lines.en: : And that’s exactly why I don’t think we should have gym class anymore.
lines.zh: : 所以说，体育课这种东西就不该存在了。

lines.en: : This breast envy of yours is really starting to get out of hand if you’re thinking of rebuilding the education system to cope with it.
lines.zh: : 你这份「胸部嫉妒」要是发展到要重建教育制度来排解，可真是有点失控了。

lines.en: : Breast envy is something that millions of girls struggle with every day, Sensei! We all know that it’s not just me who feels this way. Right, Maya?
lines.zh: : 胸部嫉妒是每天千百万女孩都要挣扎面对的问题，Sensei！大家都明白有这种感受的不止我一个。对吧，Maya？

lines.en: : Please refrain from including both me and my breasts in any conversation our teacher is a part of.
lines.zh: : 请不要把我和我的胸部，卷入任何有老师在场的对话。

lines.en: : In fact, please don’t include my breasts in any conversation. Especially when I don’t feel the same sort of envy you do.
lines.zh: : 准确地说，请不要把我的胸部卷入任何对话。尤其是在我根本没有你那种嫉妒心的情况下。

lines.en: I somehow wind up walking  back from school with Ami and two other girls who could probably pass for residents of my home on a census test if things really came down to it.
lines.zh: 不知怎么搞的，放学路上陪在 Ami 身边的还有两个女孩——真要搞人口普查，她们八成也能算作我家的住户。

lines.en: Why I was forcibly dragged along when the smallest of the bunch seems to almost always stray from anything that I’m a part of, I’m not sure.
lines.zh: 至于为什么我被硬拉来——明明这伙人里最小的那个几乎总是躲开我在场的一切活动——我就不清楚了。

lines.en: But here we are, talking about breasts or the lack thereof on the way to...
lines.zh: 但事已至此，我们正一路聊着胸部，或者没有胸部这件事，走在去……的路上。

lines.en: To...
: Where exactly are we going again?
lines.zh: : 我们到底要去哪来着？

lines.en: : Excellent question, future husband! We’re on our way to a cafe not far from here so we can take advantage of the couple’s discount they’re offering.
lines.zh: : 问得好，未来老公！我们去附近一家咖啡馆，好利用他们推出的情侣优惠。

lines.en: : We tried going as a trio last time but...things didn’t really work out the way I expected them to.
lines.zh: : 上次我们仨试过一次，但是……事情没有按我预想的发展。

lines.en: : It’s not a trio, Ami. It’s called a throuple. And the fact that the cafe would not offer us a discount proves that they are bad people who don’t care about inclusivity.
lines.zh: : 那不叫三人行，Ami。那叫三人伴侣。而咖啡馆不肯给我们打折这件事，足以证明他们是坏人，根本不在乎多元包容。

lines.en: : Then...why are we going back exactly?
lines.zh: : 那……我们为什么还要回去？

lines.en: : Because we’re hungry and you kept looking at pictures of the parfaits they’ve been posting on Instagram all day saying, “Wow. I want to go there.”
lines.zh: : 因为我们饿了，而且你一整天都在盯着他们发在 Instagram 上的芭菲照片看，嘴里念叨着「哇，好想去那里」。

lines.en: : Oh. And we also have four people now.
lines.zh: : 哦。而且我们现在有四个人了。

lines.en: : So, which one of you am I dating today?
lines.zh: : 那么，我今天要跟你们哪位约会？

lines.en: : All of us. We are a quadrouple- a real type of thing that actually exists. And if the cafe doesn’t like that, they will be met with destruction.
lines.zh: : 全部。我们是「四人伴侣」——一种真实存在的、正经的物种。咖啡馆要是看不上，就等着被毁灭吧。

lines.en: As you can see, it’s a pretty normal day for me.
lines.zh: 如你所见，对我来说，这算是相当平常的一天。

lines.en: I’m not sure how I’m going to deal with walking into a cafe for a couple’s discount with three girls who could pass for my daughters but I guess that’s a problem I’ll have to figure out how to handle later.
lines.zh: 带着三个都能当我女儿的姑娘走进咖啡馆蹭情侣优惠——这该怎么应对，我毫无头绪。不过这种麻烦，大概只能之后再想办法。

lines.en: And, as much as I’d like to say that the cafe will probably just assume I’m their teacher, I can’t really see how that would be any better than a parent.
lines.zh: 而且虽然我很想说，咖啡馆那边八成只会以为我是她们的老师——但我想不出老师这个身份会比家长强到哪里去。

lines.en: In fact, that would probably be even worse.
lines.zh: 事实上，搞不好还要更糟。

lines.en: Honestly, I think I’m kind of screwed either way. But at least I also get to screw three girls in the process.
lines.zh: 说实话，横竖我都要完蛋。但至少在这个过程里，我还能「上」三个女孩。

lines.en: Just in the less fun way.
lines.zh: 只不过是没那么快乐的那种「上」。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re okay with tagging along, Sensei? You...didn’t have anything else to do tonight?
lines.zh: : 你真的不介意跟着来吗，Sensei？你……今晚没有别的安排？

lines.en: : Since when do you care about whether or not I’m free? Isn’t wanting to be with me every waking hour of the day like, half of your personality?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始关心我有没有空了？「恨不得占用我清醒的每一分钟」不是你人格的一半吗？

lines.en: : Is the other half being lovable and fun and nice and cute and kind and cute? And also cute?
lines.zh: : 那另一半人格，是不是「可爱又有趣又温柔又可爱又善良而且可爱」？外加可爱？

lines.en: : No. It’s being annoying.
lines.zh: : 不是。是吵。

lines.en: : Mm!
: Don’t worry, Ami! I think you’re all of those things. But I think you may have forgotten to mention your best quality which is, in my opinion, how cute you are.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Ami！你说的这些你全都占。不过你好像漏了说你最大的优点——在我看来，就是你的可爱。

lines.en: : How come you can’t be more like Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你为什么就不能学学 Ayane？

lines.en: : I don’t really have the self-confidence to be hitting on myself all day long.
lines.zh: : 我可没有那份自信，整天撩自己。

lines.en: : Not that part. The part with how much she appreciates me and how she calls me cute even when I don’t have to tell her to.
lines.zh: : 不是学那个。是学她有多珍惜我，以及不用我开口，她也会夸我可爱。

lines.en: : Probably because walking around school and talking to people about how cute my niece is would likely put me on some sort of list somewhere.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为，要是在学校里到处跟人说「我侄女真可爱」，我八成会上什么名单。

lines.en: : I think that might be the most reasonable thing I’ve ever heard you say.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这可能是你说过的最有道理的一句话。

lines.en: : I’m not related to you, Sensei. You can call me cute as many times as you want and you won’t even have to worry about any lists since I am rich and can get you out of trouble if I have to.
lines.zh: : 我跟你又没血缘，Sensei。你想夸我可爱几次都行，名单什么的完全不用担心——我有钱，真出事我能捞你出来。

lines.en: : Is that really what you want me to be, Ami? Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 这就是你真想让我成为的人吗，Ami？确定？

lines.en: : You’d think I’d be offended by getting called that, but it really just made me super excited instead.
lines.zh: : 一般人被这么说会生气吧，可我反而兴奋起来了。

lines.en: : Ew.
: Okay, so maybe don’t be more like Ayane. But you are allowed to dote on me a little bit, you know.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那不用学 Ayane。但稍微宠宠我，还是允许的哦。

lines.en: : Everybody already knows we’re close, so no one is going to put you on any list if you just remind them every once in a while that I am your entire world and that you are mine.
lines.zh: : 大家本来就知道我们关系好，只要你时不时提醒他们——我是你的全世界、你是我的——没人会把你写进什么名单的。

lines.en: : Ami’s right, Sensei. You should really cherish her more.
lines.zh: : Ami 说得对，Sensei。你真该更珍惜她。

lines.en: : See what I mean? If-
lines.zh: : 看到没？就——

lines.en: : Especially since you’ll be running away with me and never looking back as soon as I graduate. If you’re not nice to Ami now, how will she remember you when that happens?
lines.zh: : 尤其是我一毕业，你就会带着我远走高飞、头也不回。你要是现在不对 Ami 好点，到那天她该怎么回忆你？

lines.en: : Just go home if you’re going to say things like that, damn it!
lines.zh: : 要说这种话你就直接回家去啊，混蛋！

lines.en: Of course, Ayane doesn’t wind up going home since she is apparently the only one who remembers how to get to the cafe.
lines.zh: 当然，Ayane 最后并没有回家，毕竟去咖啡馆的路，明摆着只有她记得。

lines.en: I highly doubt Ami is being serious when she says things like that anyway, though.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，Ami 说那种话的时候，我严重怀疑她根本没当真。

lines.en: Even with how relentless Ayane’s flirting can be, it’s clear that she and Ami are extremely close and that it’s probably just all in good fun.
lines.zh: 尽管 Ayane 的调戏火力全开，但她和 Ami 显然亲密得很，多半只是玩闹而已。

lines.en: Do I think Ami would cause physical harm to someone else for doing what Ayane does? Absolutely.
lines.zh: 要是别人敢做 Ayane 做的事，Ami 会不会动手伤人？绝对会。

lines.en: At the bare minimum, I think she’d try.
lines.zh: 至少，我觉得她会试试。

lines.en: But I think that, for whatever reason, Ayane gets a free pass.
lines.zh: 但不知为何，Ayane 就是持有免死金牌的那个。

lines.en: Eventually, we make it to what seems like less of a cafe and more of a hole in the wall that just happens to have a dessert menu.
lines.zh: 最后，我们到了地方——与其说是咖啡馆，不如说是碰巧带甜点菜单的犄角旮旯小店。

lines.en: It must be relatively new since there are still barely any decorations on the walls and the entire back half of the store is blocked off for some reason.
lines.zh: 应该是家新店，墙上几乎没有装饰，店的后半截还不知道为什么封了起来。

lines.en: I can’t say I’m really looking forward to spending my night here on account of the entire menu being full of things I wouldn’t typically consume, but...
lines.zh: 菜单上清一色都是我平时绝不入口的东西，要在这种地方消磨一晚，我是提不起什么期待的，不过……

lines.en: At the very least, I have enabled the couple’s discount the girls were after.
lines.zh: 至少，姑娘们心心念念的情侣优惠，我给成全了。

lines.en: Unless Ayane proceeds to ruin everything again by saying that we are a “quadrouple.”
lines.zh: 除非 Ayane 再来一句「我们是四人伴侣」，把一切再次搞砸。

lines.en: : Welcome in! Table for four?
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临！四位一桌吗？

lines.en: : Two tables for two, actually! We’re here for the couple’s discount.
lines.zh: : 是两桌两人！我们是冲情侣优惠来的。

lines.en: : Oh, sure! I take it you two girls are a couple then?
lines.zh: : 哦，好的！那这两位姑娘是一对咯？

lines.en: : We are!
lines.zh: : 是的！

lines.en: : I have never seen this girl in my life.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从没见过这个女人。

lines.en: : Maya, what are you doing?
lines.zh: : Maya，你干什么？

lines.en: : What? It’s only a 10%% discount. I’m going to be spending basically the same amount of money either way.
lines.zh: : 怎么？才打九折。反正最后我花的钱都差不多。

lines.en: : Okay, but that’s not why we’re doing this, remember?
lines.zh: : 行，但我们来这可不是为了省钱，记得吗？
: 那个……

lines.en: : Just go along with it and I’ll pay for you, okay?
lines.zh: : 你就配合一下，我帮你付钱，好不好？

lines.en: : I am in love with this woman.
lines.zh: : 我深爱着这个女人。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
: Oh! Well...that would certainly make the two of you a couple then.
lines.zh: : 哦！那……你们两位确实算一对了。

lines.en: : Follow me right this way. I’ll take you to a table in the back where you two won’t be interrupted.
lines.zh: : 这边请。我带你们去后面的位子，保证没人打扰你们。

lines.en: : Good. I would not want someone to overhear me talking about all of the love that I have for this person.
lines.zh: : 很好。我可不想让人偷听到我诉说对这个人的满腔爱意。

lines.en: : And you two near the door, will you also be-
lines.zh: : 还有门口那两位，你们也是——

lines.en: : Wait...I’m sorry, Sir. But you seem a little too old to be-
lines.zh: : 等等……抱歉，先生。但您年纪好像有点太大了，不太适合——

lines.en: : I consent to a romantic relationship with this man and am not being taken here against my will.
lines.zh: : 我自愿与此人恋爱，并非被胁迫来此。

lines.en: : I’m her uncle and we don’t need the discount.
lines.zh: : 我是她叔叔。我们不需要优惠。

lines.en: : Sensei, what the heck?! We were so close.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你搞什么？！就差一点点了啊。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’m going to be paying anyway and a 10%% discount is not worth what little pride I have left.
lines.zh: : 没事。反正钱都是我付，剩那点尊严，可不值得拿去换九折。

lines.en: : If it were 20%%, that would be a different story.
lines.zh: : 要是打八折，倒还可以另当别论。

lines.en: : A...table near the window it is, then.
lines.zh: : 那……就、就窗边那桌吧。

lines.en: : Please wait one moment.
lines.zh: : 请稍等片刻。

lines.en: Ayane and Maya are taken to a table in the back to make out or something while Ami and I wait near the door for the barista-slash-waitress or whatever she is to return.
lines.zh: Ayane 和 Maya 被领去后面那桌——大概是亲热去了；我和 Ami 在门口等着那位咖啡师兼服务员，或者随便她是什么的，回来。

lines.en: We’re seated shortly after and Ami, who apparently does not care at all about how much money I am willing to spend today, orders way too much food.
lines.zh: 不久我们就座了。Ami 完全不在乎我今天愿意掏多少钱，狂点了一堆东西。

lines.en: Surprisingly, it’s all taken over to us within five minutes- along with a complimentary pot of hot tea that I will consume, unlike all of the other brightly colored desserts that have now joined us at the table.
lines.zh: 出乎意料，五分钟内全上齐了——还附赠一壶热茶，这个我会喝；至于桌上其他那些花花绿绿的甜品，那就随它们去了。

lines.en: : You know, Sensei...I really wouldn’t have minded if you just decided to go along with the couples thing.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Sensei……你要是真顺着「情侣」那套演下去，我其实一点都不会介意。

lines.en: : I have done my research and know what I have to say to avoid getting you into trouble with anyone who does not understand the way we feel about one another.
lines.zh: : 我做过功课，知道该说什么，才不会让你被那些不理解我们感情的人找麻烦。

lines.en: : What way? We’re literally just related and haven’t done anything romantic together.
lines.zh: : 什么感情？我们就是普通亲戚，什么浪漫的事都没做过。

lines.en: : Right, yeah. I obviously know that. But what I’m saying is that we could and it would be okay because I’ve done my research.
lines.zh: : 对，对。我当然知道。但我的意思是——我们可以做，而且做了也没事，因为我做过功课。

lines.en: : Is there something you’d like to admit to me, Ami? Like...perhaps something about your feelings for me?
lines.zh: : 你是不是有什么想向我坦白的，Ami？比如……关于你对我的心意什么的？

lines.en: : Boy! This cake sure looks good, doesn’t it?!
lines.zh: : 嘿！这蛋糕看起来真好吃，是不是？！

lines.en: : I’m so glad that my uncle, who I’m not romantically involved with, is buying it for me today on this totally normal day of no importance whatsoever!
lines.zh: : 我好高兴，今天这个毫无意义、平平无奇的日子里，跟我没有任何恋爱关系的叔叔要买给我！

lines.en: : You should be glad. I’m spending probably an entire day’s worth of pay at this place for you.
lines.zh: : 你是该高兴。为了你，我今天差不多要在这搭进去一整天的工资。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that’s your fault. You could have afforded another parfait if you just swallowed what little is left of your pride and pretended to be in love with me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，但那是你自己造成的。你要是肯咽下所剩无几的自尊，假装跟我谈恋爱，多买一份芭菲的钱都有。

lines.en: : I’m not even going to eat this parfait. Parfaits are not currency and mean nothing to me.
lines.zh: : 这份芭菲我根本不会吃。芭菲不是货币，对我来说毫无意义。

lines.en: : Why would you even order it then?
lines.zh: : 那你还点它干嘛？

lines.en: : Because the alternative would have been sitting here without any food. And there is nothing more disconcerting than an older man bringing a young girl to a cafe and just...watching her eat.
lines.zh: : 因为不点的话，我就得干坐在这里。还有一个年长男人带小女孩来咖啡馆，自己什么都不点、就……看着她吃，世上没有比这更让人不安的画面了。

lines.en: : Yeah...I guess it does sound kinda weird when I think of that happening with any other couple.
lines.zh: : 也是……想想换一对情侣这么干，确实有点怪。

lines.en: : But you and me are different, I think.
lines.zh: : 但你我不同，我觉得。

lines.en: : I think that we look like the type of couple who could do pretty much anything normal couples do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们看起来，就像那种正常情侣能做的事，我们都能做的那种。

lines.en: : Because even if we might seem mismatched on the outside at first...the way we feel about each other shines brighter than a sea of diamonds and cuts through the outside entirely.
lines.zh: : 因为就算乍一看我们不般配……我们对彼此的感情，也亮过一整片钻石之海，能彻底穿透表面。

lines.en: : I think that anyone who takes a look at us...a real look and not just a quick one...I think that anyone who does that will understand that what we have isn’t that abnormal at all.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，只要有谁肯认真看我们一眼……是认真地看，而不是匆匆一瞥……那个人就会明白，我们拥有的东西，其实一点也不异常。

lines.en: : And I think you’re insane.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得你疯了。

lines.en: : Hahahah! Maybe I am!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！也许是吧！

lines.en: : But I know that if I were to change...and if I were to stop being as annoying as you say I am...that you’d change too.
lines.zh: : 但我知道，要是我变了……要是我不像你说的那么吵了……你也会跟着变。

lines.en: : And that’s the last thing I want.
lines.zh: : 那是我最不想要的结果。

lines.en: : I love you exactly the way you are, Sensei. Flaws and all.
lines.zh: : 我就爱你现在的样子，Sensei。连缺点一起。

lines.en: : And I’m happy you came here with me today.
lines.zh: : 今天你陪我来了，我很开心。

lines.en: : Even if we didn’t manage to get the couple's discount.
lines.zh: : 哪怕情侣优惠没拿到手。

lines.en: : Say aaaaahhh...my sweet, little princess.
lines.zh: : 张嘴，啊——……我的小公主。

lines.en: : How dare you take advantage of my one and only weakness like this. You will rue the day, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你竟敢这样利用我唯一的软肋。你会后悔的，Ayane。

lines.en: : You say that, and yet I’ve already fed you an entire parfait. Don’t pretend you’re not enjoying this, Maya. Because if you weren’t, you wouldn’t keep opening your mouth for me.
lines.zh: : 你嘴上这么说，可我已经喂你吃完了一整份芭菲。别装了，Maya，你明明很享受。不然你干嘛一直乖乖张嘴。

lines.en: : Please don’t say such revolting things while there is food on the table.
lines.zh: : 桌上摆着食物的时候，请不要说这么让人作呕的话。

lines.en: : You really think it’s revolting?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得恶心？

lines.en: : Well...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……

lines.en: : Maybe not as revolting as it could be...
lines.zh: : 也许没有恶心到那个程度……

lines.en: : When do you think he’ll remember it’s her birthday?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他什么时候会想起来，今天是她生日？

lines.en: : Hopefully soon. I even flat-out reminded him the other day.
lines.zh: : 希望快点吧。前几天我可是直截了当提醒过他。

lines.en: : Oh? When did that happen?
lines.zh: : 哦？什么时候的事？

lines.en: : When he decided to be annoying and stop by the shrine for literally no reason other than to bother me.
lines.zh: : 就是他闲得发慌、专门跑到神社来烦我那次。

lines.en: : I don’t get it at all. What do you two even see in him? He has literally zero good qualities.
lines.zh: : 我完全搞不懂。你们俩到底看上他哪一点？他压根没有任何优点。

lines.en: : Probably the same thing you do.
lines.zh: : 大概跟你看上的一样。

lines.en: : Huh? Me?
lines.zh: : 诶？我？

lines.en: : Are you confusing me with someone else? Because I do everything I possibly can to stay away from him.
lines.zh: : 你是不是认错人了？我可是想尽一切办法躲着他。

lines.en: : I guess I’m confusing you with someone else then.
lines.zh: : 那大概是我认错人了。

lines.en: : He’s not...
lines.zh: : 他该不会……

lines.en: : He’s not going to remember at all, is he?
lines.zh: : 他根本不会想起来，对吧？

lines.en: : There’s always next year.
lines.zh: : 反正还有明年。

lines.en: We stay at the cafe for a little over an hour before we decide to head home.
lines.zh: 我们在咖啡馆待了一个多小时，然后决定回家。

lines.en: And, in case you were wondering, I did wind up eating the parfait.
lines.zh: 顺便一提，如果你好奇的话——那份芭菲，最后进了我的肚子。

lines.en: It was just okay.
lines.zh: 就那样吧，还行。

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]！
